scientific_integrity: A proof for the stated power-law regime and model is included; computational tests corroborate but do not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Independently sampled, isotropic, length-bounded geodesic arcs on the round real projective plane; small-length exponent strictly greater than one. No assertion for critical/subcritical tails, nonuniform direction laws, or independently established priority.
title: Poisson extremes of crossing degrees for random projective geodesic arcs
